The '''"Tracker" GPS Module''' was a model of [[automap]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It retailed for 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team deployed to [[NCW-781]] as part of [[Operation: Shadowstrike]] were equipped with a "Tracker" GPS Module.<ref name="OS" />
